name: lost-and-found-platform
description: Developer commands for the Lost & Found platform. Each app keeps its own package.json and lockfile (backend/, frontend/).

scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.test:db: docker start lf-testdb 2>/dev/null || docker run -d --name lf-testdb -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=test -p 5544:5432 postgres:16-alpine
scripts.e2e:up: docker compose -p lftest -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.e2e.yml up -d --build --wait
scripts.e2e:down: docker compose -p lftest -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.e2e.yml down -v
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run check:bundle
